item.title: Redis Distributed Practice (Part 4): Cluster Architecture, Online Resharding, and Python Client Development
item.description: Part 4 of the Redis Distributed Practice series: In-depth analysis of the Redis Cluster 16384 hash slots sharding mechanism and decentralized Gossip protocol, hands-on deployment of a 7000~7005 six-node distributed cluster, live horizontal scaling with 800 slots resharding, graceful node decommissioning, and Python client integration with standalone instances, Sentinel read/write splitting, and Redis Cluster with compatibility pitfall solutions.

item.title: K8S ServiceAccount in Action: Authorizing in-Pod Python Applications to Securely Access APIServer
item.description: An in-depth exploration of Kubernetes ServiceAccount management across imperative and declarative paradigms. Hands-on demonstration of containerized Python applications calling the Kubernetes APIServer via in-pod SA Tokens, combined with complete RBAC chain severance verification.
